title.en-US: Why every roundabout needs a second opinion

summary.en-US: A roundabout that looks right on paper can still jam at rush hour. Here is how we check.

body.en-US:
A roundabout is a simple idea with a surprising number of ways to go wrong.

## Check the approaches

Every arm has to be modelled at peak flow, not average flow. Queues form where drivers hesitate, and that is rarely where the drawings say they will.

## Walk it

We walk the junction at the time it will be busiest. A model cannot tell you how a bus driver judges a gap.

seoDescription.en-US: Why roundabouts need a second check at peak flow, and why walking the junction still matters.
